answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the gale of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the trellis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The prism of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
